history.new: Substitutions on one symbol form (N, +, x); on two symbols modulo commutation composition is non-commutative (154/200 random pairs).

hypothesis: Endomorphisms of {a}* (substitutions a -> w) with pointwise juxtaposition (f+g)(u) = f(u)g(u) and composition form a commutative semiring isomorphic to (N, +, x) via f -> f(a). With two symbols modulo commutation, composition is no longer commutative.
methodology: Represent an endomorphism by the image of a (a word). Implement substitution and juxtaposition on strings only; check every semiring axiom on all images a^0..a^K; check the length map is a homomorphism. For {a,b}/commutation, sample substitutions and look for non-commuting compositions.
question: Is there a second operation on unary numerals that arises from transformations alone?

summary: semiring axioms + length homomorphism checked on all images a^0..a^12: 0 failures
